claims.text: Many reviewers say the brush heats up quickly and works well for straightening hair, including on beards and long hair.
Several reviewers find it convenient and easy to use, especially for quick morning straightening or managing natural hair.
Some reviewers report problems with the buttons being too sensitive or poorly placed, causing accidental power changes while using it.
A few reviewers experienced the device not turning on or shutting off and failing to work properly.
Some reviewers note the display only shows Celsius with no way to switch to Fahrenheit.
